title: Underived canonical open base-change compatibility
statement: Let $U'\xrightarrow{g_U}U$ and $X'\xrightarrow{g}X$ form an open-immersion square with open immersions $j:U\to X$ and $j':U'\to X'$, let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring, and let $F$ be a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $U_{\mathrm{Et}}$. Let $b_{g,F}:g^{-1}j_!F\xrightarrow{\sim}j'_!g_U^{-1}F$ be the canonical map of [lem-cbc-extension-zero-base-change], and let $\beta_F:j'_!g_U^{-1}F\to g^{-1}j_!F$ be the module base-change map of [def-weil-pbc-etale-shriek-base-change-map]. Then $b_{g,F}=\beta_F^{-1}$. More explicitly, under $j'_!\dashv j'^{-1}$ the map $b_{g,F}^{-1}$ is the transpose of $s_g\circ g_U^{-1}(\eta_{j,F})$, where $\eta_{j,F}:F\to j^{-1}j_!F$ is the extension-by-zero unit and $s_g:g_U^{-1}j^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}j'^{-1}g^{-1}$ is the module-linear cartesian inverse-image identification. After identifying both restrictions with $g_U^{-1}F$ through these units and $s_g$, the restriction of $b_{g,F}$ is the identity.
